articleTitle: Why Getting Out of Bed When You Can't Sleep Actually Works
imageHeadline: Can't Sleep? Get Out of Bed.
imageSubtext: The counterintuitive strategy that actually retrains your brain
pinTitle: Why Getting Out of Bed When You Can't Sleep Works (Stimulus Control for Insomnia)
pinDescription: It sounds backwards, but stimulus control—a core technique from cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia—helps retrain your brain to associate bed with sleep, not frustration. Learn how this evidence-based approach works and when to use it.
